name: Eyes & tears

overlay.caption: focus → fewer blinks → tear film dries → eyes sting

does: Shows blinking dropping sharply in the first minutes of concentrating
Shows the thin film of tears on the eye drying out the longer blinks stay rare
Shows short look-away breaks letting the tear film recover
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include screen brightness, room air or how close the screen is
Say anything about eyesight or glasses
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Eyes that stay red, sore or blurry after resting are a reason to tell an adult.

sources: NIH National Eye Institute: tips for eye health and screen use (student overview)
